title: MemberProvisioningDeleteResponseDataType
description: Response for Member Deletion provisioning requests.

code.description: Outcome code: OK, MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, or ERROR.

description.description:
Human readable explanation of the code. Examples:
- OK: The information about deleting the member has been registered.
- MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: The member with the specified id does not exist.
- ERROR: An internal error occurred; see errorMessage for stack trace.

errorMessage.description: Optional error details or stack trace when code is ERROR.
